title: Epsilon-greedy, UCB1, and Thompson sampling
brief: Keep running means, choose arms three ways, and measure which strategies' regret grows only logarithmically.
hints: The running mean after n + 1 rewards is q + (reward - q) / (n + 1). A constant alpha replaces 1 / (n + 1) and weights recent rewards more.
np.argmax always returns the lowest index among ties. Use np.flatnonzero(Q == Q.max()) and pick one of those with rng.choice.
ucb1_scores divides by the count, so fill the result with np.inf first and write scores only where counts > 0.
rng.beta(1 + successes, 1 + failures) draws one sample per arm in one call. Thompson sampling picks the argmax of the samples, never of the posterior means.
Regret adds bandit.regret(arm), the gap between the best mean and the pulled arm's mean, not the reward you happened to receive.
